names: Mount Elliott Company Metallurgical Plant and Mill
mapIdentity.scope: Queensland Heritage Register boundary 602256 and the mapped Mount Isa railway anchor the archaeological site. The register gives the south crusher group, adjacent north furnace foundations, the large vat to their west, four round vats to its north, and the northern works along the railway. Component spans and exact site positions use the registered sizes and approximate group positions.

note: Use the independently frozen 512 m Terrarium grid. Set each group onto its local elevation at the corners and estimated levels at the center. The site slopes toward the Mount Isa railway. Preserve open tank interiors, an open flue and concrete and adobe ruins.
